# Universal Node Graph — Flexible Solutioning

> A domain-neutral graph programming, compilation, search, and experimentation architecture.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Project overview and runnable examples
- [Getting started](GETTING_STARTED.md): Install, explore, author, validate, and contribute
- [Readiness](READINESS.md): Supported, experimental, unsafe, and unavailable surfaces
- [Normative specification](UNIVERSAL_NODE_GRAPH_SPEC.md): Required ontology and invariants
- [Research foundations](RESEARCH_FOUNDATIONS.md): Primary-source design rationale
- [AutoResearch and Cholesky review](AUTORESEARCH_REVIEW.md): Package identity, campaign isolation, lineage, promotion, and numerical nodes
- [LLM harness integration](LLM_HARNESS.md): Repository instruction and skill map
- [Node repository protocol](NODE_REPOSITORY_PROTOCOL.md): Reusable packs, descriptors, embeddings, handshake, snapshots
- [Solution template protocol](SOLUTION_TEMPLATE_PROTOCOL.md): Cross-domain stages, atomic slots, and bounded refinement
- [Execution protocol](EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md): Frozen plans, runtimes, artifacts, recovery, verification, and receipts
- [Executable examples](REAL_WORLD_EXAMPLES.md): Six runnable programs across five domain notebook families and extension gates
- [Agent playbook](AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md): Patterns, anti-patterns, and implementation workflow
- [Full architecture blueprint](UNIVERSAL_GRAPH_SYSTEM.md): Extended design and viewer model
- [Workbench guide](WORKBENCH.md): Interactive hierarchical candidate explorer

## Code

- [Universal core](solutiongraph/): Semantic model, discovery, templates, compiler, search, adaptive allocation, campaign lineage, evidence
- [Reference executor](solutiongraph/executor.py): Strict plan recheck and replaceable runtime adapter boundary
- [Subprocess runtime](solutiongraph/subprocess_runtime.py): Bounded trusted-code lifecycle process adapter
- [Receipt journal](solutiongraph/ledger.py): Fsync-backed, content-chained local evidence persistence
- [Workspace scaffold](solutiongraph/scaffold.py): Transactional coding-harness task initialization
- [Campaign contracts](solutiongraph/campaign.py): Hard budgets, population ancestry, evaluator boundaries, and decisions
- [Artifact stores](solutiongraph/artifacts.py): Content-addressed memory and local-file stores
- [Executable domain pack](solutiongraph/examples/): Web, document, image, data-cleanup, regression, and classification examples
- [Example notebooks](notebooks/): Five end-to-end compile, execute, verify, and receipt notebooks
- [Wire schemas](solutiongraph/schemas/): JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts
- [Reference catalogue](catalog/): 19 semantic templates and two portable node packs
- [Browser adapter](browsergraph/): Concrete runtime proof
- [Universal conformance tests](tests/test_solutiongraph.py): Executable architecture requirements
- [Create-template skill](.agents/skills/create-solution-template/SKILL.md): Strict template authoring workflow
- [Author-node-pack skill](.agents/skills/author-node-pack/SKILL.md): Reusable node publication workflow
- [Benchmark skill](.agents/skills/benchmark-solution-graph/SKILL.md): Route experiment workflow
- [Execution skill](.agents/skills/execute-solution-graph/SKILL.md): Runtime and executable-domain workflow
- [AutoResearch campaign skill](.agents/skills/design-autoresearch-campaign/SKILL.md): Bounded generated-code improvement workflow
- [Workspace modeling skill](.agents/skills/model-solution-graph/SKILL.md): End-to-end agent workflow
